title: LAS/SBS JDex now available as OPML
summary: If you use an outliner, this might be handy.
content:
The Life Admin and Small Business System JDex downloads now include an OPML file. OPML files are designed for outliners, a class of app that makes a lot of sense for a hierarchical structure like Johnny.Decimal.

Thanks to Scott for the request. He recommends Kosshi. It looks cool, which it would because the author is Japanese.
